text: Hydro-CPS-Sim 文档 面向供水网络信息物理系统安全研究的联合仿真平台。 Hydro-CPS-Sim 将水力过程、PLC 控制、SCADA 通信与网络仿真连接起来，用于运行攻击实验、观察系统行为和开发安全方法。 源代码： WandeF/hydro-cps-sim 项目概览 跨层联合仿真 ：连接水力模型、控制逻辑和通信过程，观察网络层事件如何影响物理水网。 攻击实验 ：提供 MITM、DoS 和 PLC 逻辑注入场景，可调整目标、参数和时间窗口。 配置与运行 ：使用 YAML 设置场景，通过脚本启动仿真并导出日志与 CSV 结果。 面向研究扩展 ：围绕控制、网络和物理层扩展实验设置，用于研究攻击传播、异常检测及防御策略。 开始使用时，先完成 安装 ，再运行 快速开始 中的 C-Town 示例。 了解平台 查看 系统架构与闭环流程 、 C-Town 控制依赖 以及 攻击类型与示例配置 ，了解平台如何连接网络、控制与水力过程。 文档目录 项目概览 项目简介 系统架构 使用指南 安装与环境 快速开始 实验与配置 攻防实验 配置说明 社区与研究 论文与引用 贡献与反馈

title: 项目简介
description: 项目简介 水务信息物理系统 水务信息物理系统将供水管网、传感器、控制器和通信网络连接起来。传感器采集水位、压力和流量，PLC 根据这些数据控制泵阀，SCADA 负责监测和数据转发。泵阀动作改变管网状态，新的测量数据再进入下一轮控制。 研究这类系统的安全性，需要同时观察网络通信、控制程序和水
text: 项目简介 水务信息物理系统 水务信息物理系统将供水管网、传感器、控制器和通信网络连接起来。传感器采集水位、压力和流量，PLC 根据这些数据控制泵阀，SCADA 负责监测和数据转发。泵阀动作改变管网状态，新的测量数据再进入下一轮控制。 研究这类系统的安全性，需要同时观察网络通信、控制程序和水力过程。例如，传感器数据被修改后，PLC 可能改变泵的启停状态；通信中断时，控制器也可能继续使用上一次收到的数据。 平台概览 Hydro-CPS-Sim 是面向供水系统安全研究的联合仿真平台。它将 EPANET 水力模型、OpenPLC 控制程序、Modbus TCP 通信和 ns-3 网络连接在同一闭环中，支持 MITM、DoS 和 PLC 逻辑注入实验。 你可以通过配置文件选择水网模型、控制规则、网络拓扑和攻击场景。运行时，平台启动各个组件，完成数据交换和水力计算，并保存日志与 CSV 结果。源代码位于 GitHub 仓库 。 平台组件 水力仿真 DHALSIM-epynet / EPANET 计算水箱水位、节点压力和管道流量。PLC 输出的泵阀状态用于更新水力模型，因此控制变化会反映在后续的水力状态中。 PLC 与 SCADA OpenPLC 执行结构化文本（ST）控制程序。SCADA 使用 Modbus TCP 读取传感器数据，并将跨 PLC 的控制依赖转发给相应控制器。PLC Adapter 负责衔接水力数据与 PLC 输入输出。 通信网络 Linux network namespace 为 PLC、SCADA 和攻击节点提供独立的网络环境。各节点通过 TAP/veth 接入 ns-3，可以配置链路带宽、时延和网络拓扑。 攻击与结果记录 平台提供 Modbus 数据篡改、UDP DoS 和 PLC 逻辑注入功能。攻击可以作用于通信数据、网络路径或控制规则。运行过程中记录传感器观测、执行器状态、攻击事件和水力变量，便于比较不同实验的系统行为。 C-Town 示例 C-Town 示例包含多个 PLC 控制区域。部分控制器使用其他区域采集的水位数据，由 SCADA 完成转发。 C-Town 水网拓扑、PLC 控制分区与跨区数据依赖。 PLC间的逻辑关系 数据来源 经 SCADA 转发后的控制用途 PLC2 的 T1 PLC1 对 PU1、PU2 的控制 PLC3 的 T2、T3 本地 V2 与 PU4、PU5 的控制 PLC6 的 T5 PLC4 对 PU8 的控制 PLC8 的 T7 PLC4 对 PU10、PU11 的控制 PLC7 的 T4 PLC5 对 PU6、PU7 的控制 PLC4 同时监测本地 T6 水位，并使用 T5、T7 数据控制相应水泵。 环境与扩展 平台运行于 Ubuntu，使用 Python 协调水力、控制和网络组件。各组件按功能组织在独立模块中，你可以修改 YAML 配置来调整场景，也可以扩展控制、网络或攻击模块。环境要求见 安装与环境 ，第一个实验见 快速开始 。

title: 系统架构
description: 系统架构 Hydro-CPS-Sim 由水力仿真、PLC 控制、SCADA、网络和攻击模块组成。各模块通过数据交换和状态同步共同完成闭环仿真。 平台总体架构 平台总体架构：场景配置、联合仿真编排与各运行模块。 模块 功能 场景配置 YAML 描述水网、PLC/SCADA 映射、控制规则、网
text: 系统架构 Hydro-CPS-Sim 由水力仿真、PLC 控制、SCADA、网络和攻击模块组成。各模块通过数据交换和状态同步共同完成闭环仿真。 平台总体架构 平台总体架构：场景配置、联合仿真编排与各运行模块。 模块 功能 场景配置 YAML 描述水网、PLC/SCADA 映射、控制规则、网络、攻击与运行参数 联合仿真编排 生成 ST 程序、编译 PLC、生成网络环境、启动进程并导出结果 物理过程 DHALSIM-epynet / EPANET 推进水力状态，接收泵阀动作 控制与监控 OpenPLC 执行控制逻辑；PLC Adapter 衔接输入输出；SCADA 通过 Modbus TCP 采集与转发数据 网络通信 Linux network namespace 提供独立网络身份，经 TAP/veth 接入 ns-3 攻击执行 在配置的协议、网络或控制入口执行 MITM、DoS 或逻辑注入 同步 通过文件系统标志协调多进程，按实验轮次交换状态 数据记录 汇集攻击、通信、控制、执行器与水力记录，供基线对照使用 闭环运行流程 闭环运行流程：场景生成、数据采集、控制执行与水力反馈。 环境生成 ：读取水网和 YAML 配置，生成控制程序、地址映射、ns-3 拓扑与命名空间配置。 初始化 ：启动 OpenPLC、SCADA 与网络进程，准备物理状态和同步目录。 采集与转发 ：水力模块提供当前传感器状态，SCADA 通过 Modbus TCP 采集数据并转发跨 PLC 控制依赖。 控制执行 ：OpenPLC 根据当前输入和有效规则生成泵阀命令。 水力反馈 ：执行器状态进入下一步水力求解，产生新的水位、压力和流量。 保存结果 ：记录当前轮次的数据，然后进入下一轮仿真。 网络连接 每个 PLC、SCADA 和攻击节点运行在各自的 Linux network namespace 中，拥有独立接口和协议栈。ns-3 为这些端点提供可配置的链路、路由与网络动态。正常 Modbus 通信和攻击流量通过配置的网络路径交互。 SCADA 通过 Modbus TCP 访问 PLC 的寄存器和线圈，完成传感器采集和控制数据下发。网络参数影响这些请求和响应，你可以通过日志查看通信、数据更新与控制输出。 代码入口 scripts/run_all.sh ：环境准备、运行和清理的总入口。 src/control/ ：ST 程序生成、编译与 OpenPLC 启动。 src/network/ ：命名空间与 ns-3 拓扑生成。 src/runtime/ 、 src/sync/ ：闭环协调与同步。 src/scada/ 、 src/plc/ 、 src/comm/ ：数据采集、适配与 Modbus 交互。 src/attack/ ：攻击启动与执行。 src/io/ ：水力接口与结果导出。 使用方法参见 快速开始 ，运行参数参见 配置说明 。

title: 安装与环境
description: 安装与环境 使用 install.sh 安装 Hydro-CPS-Sim 及其依赖。安装过程会配置系统软件包、Conda 环境、OpenPLC 命令行运行时、ns-3 和 DHALSIM-epynet。 支持的环境 项目 要求 操作系统 Ubuntu 22.04 / 24.04，x86_6
text: 安装与环境 使用 install.sh 安装 Hydro-CPS-Sim 及其依赖。安装过程会配置系统软件包、Conda 环境、OpenPLC 命令行运行时、ns-3 和 DHALSIM-epynet。 支持的环境 项目 要求 操作系统 Ubuntu 22.04 / 24.04，x86_64 Python 3.10（安装脚本创建的 Conda 环境） 环境管理 Conda 系统权限 安装和网络配置环节需要 sudo 网络连接 安装依赖及克隆所需仓库 主体依赖 OpenPLC 命令行运行时、ns-3、DHALSIM-epynet 安装包含 OpenPLC 命令行运行时，不包含 Web 管理服务。 获取源码 git clone https://github.com/WandeF/hydro-cps-sim.git cd hydro-cps-sim 查看安装计划 查看安装计划，不修改系统： bash install.sh --dry-run 正式安装 运行安装脚本： bash install.sh conda activate hydro-cps 安装过程中可能需要较长时间编译 OpenPLC 和 ns-3。默认环境名为 hydro-cps ；脚本也支持 --env 、 --jobs 、 --parent 等参数，详见 bash install.sh --help 。 安装完成后的自检 安装程序会检查 EPANET 动态库并运行 Python 单元测试。你也可以手动运行测试： python -m unittest discover -s tests 安装完成后，继续 快速开始 运行 C-Town 示例。 安装脚本会更新所有 C-Town 示例 YAML 的五个顶层路径键，并将修改前的文件保存到 output/install-backups/ 。更换机器或依赖目录时，更新配置中的路径。

title: 快速开始
description: 快速开始 安装完成后，使用 C-Town 示例运行第一个闭环仿真实验。 每次运行会清理配置输出目录中的 runtime/ 、 reports/ 、 st/ 和 plcs/ 。开始另一个实验前，请将需要比较的结果复制到独立目录。使用普通用户启动，脚本会按需请求 sudo。 运行一个示例 cd
text: 快速开始 安装完成后，使用 C-Town 示例运行第一个闭环仿真实验。 每次运行会清理配置输出目录中的 runtime/ 、 reports/ 、 st/ 和 plcs/ 。开始另一个实验前，请将需要比较的结果复制到独立目录。使用普通用户启动，脚本会按需请求 sudo。 运行一个示例 cd hydro-cps-sim conda activate hydro-cps bash scripts/run_all.sh --logic-wait 0.3 使用 --iterations 设置仿真轮数。下面运行 10 轮： bash scripts/run_all.sh --iterations 10 --logic-wait 0.3 此命令将仿真缩短为 10 轮，适合检查启动与结果导出流程。 自定义配置入口 bash scripts/run_all.sh --config examples/c_town/config.yaml 运行器的可选参数包括： 参数 用途 --config PATH 指定 YAML 配置文件 --iterations N 覆盖仿真轮数 --logic-wait SECONDS SCADA 下发后、读取 PLC 输出前的等待间隔 --poll-interval SECONDS 文件标志轮询间隔 --scada-modbus-workers N SCADA Modbus 并行工作线程数 具体帮助信息可由 bash scripts/run_all.sh --help 查询。 查看输出 实验结果导出到 output_path 指定目录下的 reports/csv ，日志与阶段耗时分别保存在 logs/ 和 timing/ 中。 运行结束后，终端显示结果位置： [DONE] Results: <output_path>/reports/csv 其中 <output_path> 对应配置中的输出目录。 下一步 请参考 攻防实验 了解如何组织基线与攻击条件对照，通过 配置说明 调整场景参数。

title: 攻防实验
description: 攻防实验 Hydro-CPS-Sim 提供 MITM、DoS 和 PLC 逻辑注入三类攻击。你可以设置攻击目标和生效窗口，观察攻击如何影响传感器数据、PLC 输出和水网状态。 攻击类型 MITM、DoS 和 PLC 逻辑注入在闭环中的作用位置。 MITM 数据篡改 MITM 修改 SCAD
text: 攻防实验 Hydro-CPS-Sim 提供 MITM、DoS 和 PLC 逻辑注入三类攻击。你可以设置攻击目标和生效窗口，观察攻击如何影响传感器数据、PLC 输出和水网状态。 攻击类型 MITM、DoS 和 PLC 逻辑注入在闭环中的作用位置。 MITM 数据篡改 MITM 修改 SCADA 与 PLC 之间的 Modbus 数据。例如，修改发送至 PLC4 的 T7 水位，可以改变控制器看到的输入值，从而影响 PU10 的启停判断。 DoS 通信干扰 DoS 通过 UDP 流量占用网络链路，影响正常的 Modbus 通信。采集超时时，SCADA 可能继续使用之前保存的观测值。你可以比较通信状态、数据更新时间和泵阀动作，了解旧数据对控制的影响。 PLC 逻辑注入 逻辑注入修改 PLC 中的控制规则，例如水泵的关闭阈值。修改后的规则由 OpenPLC 执行，并通过泵阀动作影响水力过程。 示例配置 当前版本提供以下示例配置，攻击窗口以控制轮次表示。 配置文件 目标或用途 攻击轮次 config.yaml 无攻击基线 — config_mitm_plc4.yaml PLC4 下行数据 20–40 config_mitm_plc9.yaml PLC8 的 T7 响应 20–40 config_mitm_composite_plc7_plc9.yaml PLC6 T5 + PLC8 T7 20–40 / 30–50 config_dos_plc2_single.yaml PLC2，单攻击节点 5–90 config_dos_plc2_three_bots.yaml PLC2，三个攻击节点 5–90 config_openplc_logic_plc4.yaml PLC4 中 PU10 的 T7 阈值 20–90 每个配置包含对应的网络、控制和攻击设置。你可以从示例开始，调整目标、攻击参数和时间窗口。 运行实验 先运行无攻击基线： bash scripts/run_all.sh --config examples/c_town/config.yaml 保存基线输出后，选择攻击配置运行，例如： bash scripts/run_all.sh --config examples/c_town/config_mitm_plc4.yaml --logic-wait 0.3 每次运行会更新输出目录。将需要比较的结果复制到独立目录后，再开始下一次实验。 查看结果 结果保存在 output_path 下的 reports/csv/ 中。 文件 内容 physics.csv 水位、压力等水力状态 actuator_state.csv 泵阀状态 scada_observed_long.csv 、 scada_observed_wide.csv 、 scada_observed_key.csv SCADA 观测数据 attack_schedule.csv 、 attack_events.csv 攻击调度与事件 scada_timeout_events.csv 通信超时记录 cycle_timing.csv 闭环各阶段的耗时 比较攻击运行和基线时，可以先查看输入数据是否改变，再查看 PLC 输出和水力状态。通信超时不一定改变泵阀动作，输入变化也可能在后续轮次才触发控制规则。 水位和压力可使用 RMSE、平均绝对偏差或最大绝对偏差进行比较。按物理时间绘图时，使用水力记录中的 sim_time 。网络和控制配置见 配置说明 。

title: 配置说明
description: 配置说明 Hydro-CPS-Sim 使用 YAML 配置文件组织实验场景，默认配置为 examples/c_town/config.yaml 。 配置文件 指定水网模型及其输入文件。 指向 OpenPLC、ns-3 等组件所在目录。 指定输出目录及仿真轮数。 保存水网控制、网络及实验设置
text: 配置说明 Hydro-CPS-Sim 使用 YAML 配置文件组织实验场景，默认配置为 examples/c_town/config.yaml 。 配置文件 指定水网模型及其输入文件。 指向 OpenPLC、ns-3 等组件所在目录。 指定输出目录及仿真轮数。 保存水网控制、网络及实验设置。 安装程序会更新示例配置中的五个顶层路径字段： 路径键 用途 root_path 第三方依赖工作目录 openplc_path OpenPLC 源码或构建目录 ns3_path ns-3 源码或构建目录 inp_file EPANET 水网输入文件 output_path 实验结果输出目录 迁移环境或更换模型时，请更新这些路径，并确保 output_path 指向专用的实验输出目录。 创建场景 复制 config.yaml 作为新场景，修改其中的水网、控制或网络参数，然后通过 --config 指定配置文件运行。 传感器与控制映射 plcs 将水网中的传感器和执行器分配给各个 PLC。跨 PLC 的数据由 SCADA 转发。 network 定义 PLC、SCADA 和攻击节点的网络端点、命名空间与连接关系。 仿真与控制参数 字段 当前基线值或作用 iterations 100；可由运行命令覆盖 noise_scale 0.0 time EPANET 总时长 86400 秒、水力步长 300 秒 physics inp_controls: strip 、 step_order: next-run 、 init_flag: 0 plcs PLC1–PLC8 的传感器、执行器与控制规则 network ns-3 后端、实时调度、路由、节点、链路、LAN 和 TAP attacks.enabled 攻击配置的总开关 attacks.scenarios 场景类型、触发器、目标和类型特有参数 攻击类型包括 modbus_mitm 、 udp_dos 和 openplc_logic_injection 。使用 trigger.type: iteration_window 设置轮次窗口， start_iteration 和 end_iteration 分别指定开始与结束轮次。各类型的节点、目标和规则可从 攻防实验 中的示例配置开始修改。

description: Hydro-CPS-Sim Documentation A co-simulation platform for water cyber-physical system security research. Hydro-CPS-Sim connects hydraulic dynamics
text: Hydro-CPS-Sim Documentation A co-simulation platform for water cyber-physical system security research. Hydro-CPS-Sim connects hydraulic dynamics, PLC control, SCADA communications, and network simulation to run attack experiments, explore system behavior and develop security methods. Source code: WandeF/hydro-cps-sim Overview Cross-layer co-simulation : Link hydraulic models, control logic, and communication processes to study how cyber events affect the physical network. Attack experiments : Use MITM, DoS and PLC logic injection scenarios with configurable targets, parameters and active windows. Configuration and execution : Set up scenarios with YAML, run simulations through scripts and export logs and CSV results. Research extensibility : Investigate control, network, and hydraulic effects within a modular experiment framework. To get started, follow Installation , then run the C-Town example in Quick Start . Explore the platform Explore the architecture and closed-loop workflow , C-Town control dependencies , and attack types and example configurations to understand how network, control and hydraulics interact. Documentation Overview Introduction Architecture Get Started Installation Quick Start Experiments & Configuration Security Experiments Configuration Research & Community Publications & Citation Contributing & Feedback

title: Introduction
description: Introduction Water cyber-physical systems A water cyber-physical system connects a distribution network with sensors, controllers and communicati
text: Introduction Water cyber-physical systems A water cyber-physical system connects a distribution network with sensors, controllers and communication networks. Sensors measure tank levels, pressures and flows. PLCs use these measurements to control pumps and valves, while SCADA monitors the system and forwards data. Actuator actions change the network state, and new measurements enter the next control cycle. Studying security in these systems involves network communication, control programs and hydraulics together. Modified sensor data can change a pump decision, while a communication failure can leave a controller using an earlier measurement. Platform overview Hydro-CPS-Sim is a co-simulation platform for water-system security research. It connects EPANET hydraulics, OpenPLC programs, Modbus TCP communication and ns-3 networking in one closed loop, with support for MITM, DoS and PLC logic injection experiments. You can select a water model, control rules, network topology and attack scenario through configuration files. The platform starts the components, coordinates data exchange and hydraulic computation, and saves logs and CSV results. Source code is available in the GitHub repository . Platform components Hydraulic simulation DHALSIM-epynet / EPANET computes tank levels, node pressures and pipe flows. Pump and valve states from the PLCs update the hydraulic model, so control changes affect subsequent hydraulic states. PLCs and SCADA OpenPLC executes Structured Text (ST) control programs. SCADA reads sensor measurements over Modbus TCP and forwards cross-PLC dependencies to the relevant controllers. PLC Adapters connect hydraulic data with PLC inputs and outputs. Communication network Linux network namespaces provide separate network environments for PLC, SCADA and attack endpoints. TAP/veth interfaces connect them to ns-3, where you can configure link bandwidth, delay and topology. Attacks and logging The platform provides Modbus data manipulation, UDP DoS and PLC logic injection. Attacks can act on communication data, network paths or control rules. Sensor observations, actuator states, attack events and hydraulic variables are recorded during execution for comparison across experiments. C-Town example The C-Town example contains several PLC control regions. Some controllers use tank measurements acquired in other regions, with SCADA forwarding the data. C-Town network topology, PLC control regions and cross-region data dependencies. Logical relationships between PLCs Measurement source Control dependency forwarded through SCADA T1 at PLC2 PU1 and PU2 at PLC1 T2 and T3 at PLC3 Local V2, PU4 and PU5 T5 at PLC6 PU8 at PLC4 T7 at PLC8 PU10 and PU11 at PLC4 T4 at PLC7 PU6 and PU7 at PLC5 PLC4 also monitors local T6 and uses T5 and T7 measurements to control the corresponding pumps. Requirements and extension The platform runs on Ubuntu and uses Python to coordinate hydraulic, control and network components. Components are organized into separate modules. You can adjust scenarios through YAML configuration or extend the control, network and attack modules. See Installation for requirements and Quick Start for your first experiment.

title: Architecture
description: Architecture Hydro-CPS-Sim includes hydraulic, PLC, SCADA, network and attack modules. Data exchange and state synchronization connect these modu
text: Architecture Hydro-CPS-Sim includes hydraulic, PLC, SCADA, network and attack modules. Data exchange and state synchronization connect these modules in a closed-loop simulation. Platform architecture Platform architecture: scenario configuration, orchestration and runtime modules. Module Function Scenario configuration YAML describes the water model, PLC/SCADA mappings, control rules, network, attacks and runtime settings Orchestration Generates ST programs, compiles PLCs, creates the network environment, starts processes and exports results Physical process DHALSIM-epynet / EPANET advances hydraulics using pump and valve states Control and supervision OpenPLC executes logic; PLC Adapters bridge I/O; SCADA acquires and forwards data over Modbus TCP Communication Linux network namespaces provide separate network identities connected to ns-3 through TAP/veth interfaces Attack execution Injects MITM, DoS or logic modifications at configured interfaces Synchronization Filesystem markers coordinate process state exchange by experiment iteration Logging Collects attack, communication, control, actuator and hydraulic records for baseline comparisons Closed-loop workflow Closed-loop workflow: scenario generation, data acquisition, control execution and hydraulic feedback. Generate the environment: Read the model and YAML, then generate control programs, address mappings, the ns-3 topology and namespace configuration. Initialize: Start OpenPLC, SCADA and network processes; prepare physical state and synchronization directories. Acquire and forward: Obtain current sensor state and use SCADA Modbus TCP exchanges to forward cross-PLC control dependencies. Execute control: OpenPLC evaluates current inputs and effective rules to produce pump and valve commands. Feed back: Apply actuator states to the next hydraulic step to obtain updated levels, pressures and flows. Save results: Record the current iteration and advance to the next simulation step. Network connections Each PLC, SCADA and attack endpoint runs in a separate Linux network namespace with its own interfaces and protocol stack. ns-3 supplies configurable links, routing and network dynamics. Normal Modbus exchanges and attack traffic follow the configured network paths. SCADA accesses PLC registers and coils over Modbus TCP to collect measurements and send control data. Network settings affect these requests and responses. Logs provide communication, measurement-update and control-output records. Source entry points scripts/run_all.sh : preparation, execution and cleanup. src/control/ : ST generation, compilation and OpenPLC launch. src/network/ : namespace and ns-3 topology generation. src/runtime/ , src/sync/ : loop coordination and synchronization. src/scada/ , src/plc/ , src/comm/ : acquisition, adapters and Modbus exchanges. src/attack/ : attack launch and execution. src/io/ : hydraulic interfaces and result exports. See Quick Start for execution and Configuration for runtime settings.

title: Installation
description: Installation Use install.sh to install Hydro-CPS-Sim and its dependencies. The installer configures system packages, a Conda environment, the Ope
text: Installation Use install.sh to install Hydro-CPS-Sim and its dependencies. The installer configures system packages, a Conda environment, the OpenPLC command-line runtime, ns-3 and DHALSIM-epynet. Environment requirements Item Requirement Operating system Ubuntu 22.04 / 24.04, x86_64 Python Python 3.10 in the Conda environment Environment manager Conda Privileges sudo is needed for installation and networking Internet Required for packages and source repositories Main dependencies OpenPLC command-line runtime, ns-3, DHALSIM-epynet Important: The installer builds the OpenPLC command-line runtime, not the full web management service. Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/WandeF/hydro-cps-sim.git cd hydro-cps-sim Preview installation steps bash install.sh --dry-run Install Run the installer: bash install.sh conda activate hydro-cps Building ns-3 and OpenPLC may take some time. The default environment is named hydro-cps ; see bash install.sh --help for --env , --jobs , and --parent options. Run the tests The installer checks EPANET library loading and runs the Python test suite. You can also run the tests manually: python -m unittest discover -s tests After installation, follow Quick Start to run the C-Town example. The installer rewrites five top-level path keys in every C-Town YAML and saves changed originals under output/install-backups/ . Update the paths when moving to another machine or dependency directory.

title: Quick Start
description: Quick Start After installation, run your first closed-loop simulation with the C-Town example. Each run clears runtime/ , reports/ , st/ , and pl
text: Quick Start After installation, run your first closed-loop simulation with the C-Town example. Each run clears runtime/ , reports/ , st/ , and plcs/ under the configured output directory. Copy results to a separate directory before the next experiment. Start as a normal user; the script requests sudo when needed. Run a simulation cd hydro-cps-sim conda activate hydro-cps bash scripts/run_all.sh --logic-wait 0.3 Use --iterations to set the run length. This example runs 10 iterations: bash scripts/run_all.sh --iterations 10 --logic-wait 0.3 This command limits the simulation to 10 iterations to check startup and result export. Select a configuration bash scripts/run_all.sh --config examples/c_town/config.yaml Option Purpose --config PATH YAML configuration file --iterations N Number of iterations --logic-wait SECONDS Wait after SCADA downlink before reading control outputs --poll-interval SECONDS Marker polling interval --scada-modbus-workers N Concurrent SCADA Modbus workers Run bash scripts/run_all.sh --help for the definitive interface. Outputs Results are exported to reports/csv under output_path . Logs and stage timings are saved in logs/ and timing/ . At completion, the script prints: [DONE] Results: <output_path>/reports/csv Here, <output_path> is the output directory set in the configuration. Continue with experiments and configuration .

title: Experiments
description: Security Experiments Hydro-CPS-Sim provides MITM, DoS and PLC logic injection attacks. You can select targets and active windows to explore how a
text: Security Experiments Hydro-CPS-Sim provides MITM, DoS and PLC logic injection attacks. You can select targets and active windows to explore how attacks affect sensor data, PLC outputs and the water network. Attack types MITM, DoS and PLC logic injection entry points in the closed loop. MITM data manipulation MITM modifies Modbus data exchanged between SCADA and PLCs. For example, changing T7 measurements sent to PLC4 changes the controller input and can affect the on/off decision for PU10. DoS communication interference DoS uses UDP traffic to occupy network links and interfere with normal Modbus communication. After a timeout, SCADA may retain an earlier observation. Compare communication state, measurement updates and actuator actions to explore the effect of stale data on control. PLC logic injection Logic injection changes PLC rules, such as a pump-off threshold. OpenPLC executes the modified rules, and resulting pump or valve actions feed back into the hydraulic model. Example configurations The current version provides the following example configurations. Attack windows are measured in control iterations. Configuration Target or purpose Attack iterations config.yaml Baseline — config_mitm_plc4.yaml PLC4 downlink 20–40 config_mitm_plc9.yaml PLC8 T7 response 20–40 config_mitm_composite_plc7_plc9.yaml PLC6 T5 + PLC8 T7 20–40 / 30–50 config_dos_plc2_single.yaml PLC2, single attack endpoint 5–90 config_dos_plc2_three_bots.yaml PLC2, three attack endpoints 5–90 config_openplc_logic_plc4.yaml T7 threshold for PU10 at PLC4 20–90 Each configuration includes its network, control and attack settings. Start with an example and adjust the target, attack parameters and active window. Running an experiment Run an attack-free baseline first: bash scripts/run_all.sh --config examples/c_town/config.yaml Save the baseline output, then select an attack configuration: bash scripts/run_all.sh --config examples/c_town/config_mitm_plc4.yaml --logic-wait 0.3 Each run updates the output directory. Copy results you want to compare to a separate directory before starting the next experiment. Reading the results Results are saved under output_path in reports/csv/ . File Contents physics.csv Hydraulic states, including levels and pressures actuator_state.csv Pump and valve states scada_observed_long.csv , scada_observed_wide.csv , scada_observed_key.csv SCADA observations attack_schedule.csv , attack_events.csv Attack scheduling and events scada_timeout_events.csv Communication timeouts cycle_timing.csv Timing of closed-loop stages When comparing an attack run with its baseline, start with input changes, then inspect PLC outputs and hydraulic states. A timeout need not change an actuator action, and an input change may trigger a control rule in a later iteration. You can compare levels and pressures using RMSE, mean absolute deviation or peak absolute deviation. Use sim_time from the hydraulic records when plotting against physical time. See Configuration for network and control settings.

title: Configuration
description: Configuration Hydro-CPS-Sim organizes experiments using YAML configuration files. The default is examples/c_town/config.yaml . Configuration file
text: Configuration Hydro-CPS-Sim organizes experiments using YAML configuration files. The default is examples/c_town/config.yaml . Configuration files Input hydraulic network files and simulation settings. External paths for OpenPLC and ns-3. Output directories and run length. Network, control, and experiment settings. The installer updates five top-level path fields in the example configurations: Key Purpose root_path Working directory for external dependencies openplc_path OpenPLC checkout or build directory ns3_path ns-3 checkout or build directory inp_file EPANET input file output_path Directory for generated results Update these paths when moving environments or replacing a model. Set output_path to a dedicated experiment output directory. Creating a scenario Copy config.yaml to create a scenario, change its water model, control or network settings, and select the file with --config when running the simulation. Sensor and control mappings The plcs section assigns sensors and actuators from the water model to PLCs. SCADA forwards cross-PLC data. The network section defines endpoints, namespaces and connections for PLC, SCADA and attack nodes. Simulation and control parameters Field Baseline value or role iterations 100; runner can override noise_scale 0.0 time EPANET duration 86400 seconds; hydraulic step 300 seconds physics inp_controls: strip , step_order: next-run , init_flag: 0 plcs Sensors, actuators and control rules for PLC1–PLC8 network ns-3 backend, realtime scheduling, routing, nodes, links, LANs and TAPs attacks.enabled Global switch in attack presets attacks.scenarios Scenario types, triggers, targets and type-specific options Attack types include modbus_mitm , udp_dos and openplc_logic_injection . Use trigger.type: iteration_window with start_iteration and end_iteration to set the active window. Start with the experiment presets to configure nodes, targets and rules for each type.

text: Publications & Citation Related research “网络攻击下水务CPS的跨层影响分析：Hydro-CPS-Sim联合仿真平台” studies how cyberattacks propagate through communication, control and hydraulic feedback. Its scope includes platform architecture, closed-loop consistency, network calibration, MITM / DoS / PLC logic injection, propagation timing and PLC scalability. See Architecture for platform design and Experiments for scenarios and analysis methods. Publication status and citation The paper is being prepared for submission. Author information, venue, year, DOI and a BibTeX entry will be provided upon publication or preprint release. text: Contributing & Feedback You are welcome to report issues, improve the documentation or contribute features. Reporting a problem Please use the project's GitHub Issues and include: OS and Python / Conda versions. Git commit and sanitized configuration files. Reproduction commands and relevant errors. Expected and actual results. Updating the website Documentation repository: WandeF/WandeF.github.io . Edit Markdown pages under content/zh/ and content/en/ , then run: python build.py Generated files are written to site/ . Preview locally with python -m http.server 8000 --directory site . Push to main in WandeF/WandeF.github.io to build and deploy automatically to https://wandef.github.io/ . Contribution areas Contributions can improve installation and configuration instructions, add reproducible examples, fix issues or refine translations. Briefly describe your changes and how you tested them. Include configurations and run records with experiment examples.
